source_quality.notes: Twenty-four pages. pdftotext warned of 27 nontrivial segments. Empty text layers on pages 2, 3, 10, 13, 16, and 24 were opened as rasters. Watermark blocks of the letter m were not paired into tables. Formula and table crops were taken at 120 dpi.

task_reconstruction.summary: Predict the 2028 medal table, including gold and total, and give an interval plus countries that may rise or fall.
Estimate which never-medaled countries win a first medal in 2028.
Test a great-coach effect and name three countries and sports for a hire.
Report other medal patterns to national Olympic committees.

section_map.summary: Summary sheet: API, a forest, a BP classifier, swimming, and a coach percent.
Contents. Introduction through conclusions, then references.
Three assumptions, a notation table, and the start of data processing.
The 2028 virtual medal table and the bootstrap steps.
Coach importance 0.288 and the EPI display.
Sensitivity by training-set size, then strengths.

contributions.summary: API decays PWM by one half per Games, and PWM scores a no-medal event at 60.
A BP classifier at AUC 0.94 ranks 77 never-medaled countries, with Guam at 0.153.
A binary coach feature has importance 0.288, and EPI is defined without numeric weights.

dependency_graph.summary: AAPI is the average of API and becomes a forest feature.
The first-medal classifier refuses the medal-count forest because Total is always 0.
Total_trend uses the 2028 prediction from the medal forest.

assumptions.summary: Ability is fully inferred from the given medal history.
Ability is constant across the four years between Games.
A never-medaled country's chance depends only on past participation, followed by an Although fragment.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: 1906 is dropped. 1904, 1908, and 1984 are dropped as fluctuations.
Seventy-two ?? NOC cells are removed. Great Britain and United Kingdom are standardized, with no map shown.
Participation is binned into five PS levels.

models.summary: API is a half-life sum and PWM is a four-term linear score.
A grid-searched forest is the medal model after a three-way comparison.
A BP network classifies a first medal.
Event importance comes from a forest on PWMA.
EPI is a weighted sum of trend, space, and AAPI.

verification.summary: Holdout R2 0.8792 and 5-fold R2 0.7642, with a concession about poor folds.
Bootstrap percentile intervals, fit separately by medal color and by total.
Training fractions 60, 70, and 80 percent, then a result sentence that also names 75 percent.

results_trace.summary: USA is the increase and South Korea is the decrease in the printed table.
Guam, ESA, Liberia, and Palestine head the partial first-medal list.
China women's gymnastics, Jamaica men's athletics, and Germany men's shooting are the three hires, at about 1.6 medals.

writing_logic.summary: Each summary block starts with First, Then, Subsequently, Next, or Finally, then a method, then one number.
Each assumption is We assume that, then This is because.
A close fit is broken by a Given phrase about interpretability.

language_observations.summary: Finally We has no comma, and a sentence starts with lowercase we.
in most of the time, and the citation sits against the period.
The third assumption ends on an Although fragment.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1 is a Paris 2024 medal table beside an empty LA 2028 table. USA 40, 44, 42, total 126. China 40, 27, 24, total 91. Japan 20, 12, 13, total 45. Australia 18, 19, 16, total 53. France 16, 16, 22, total 64. Netherlands 15, 7, 12, total 34. A question-mark figure covers the 2028 side.
Figure 2 is the work flowchart. Forest hyperparameters 180, 10, and 4, R2 0.8792, coach contribution 28.8 percent, and the two AAPI increment lines.
Figure 3 maps four source files to defects and maps Outlier to Delete and Missing to two filling boxes. Both program defects are labeled A-AI column.
Table 2 maps athlete counts 0-9, 10-49, 50-99, 100-149, and 150 or more onto PS levels 1 through 5. Table 3 lists Year, N_A, N_E, AAPI, PS, HS, N_G, N_S, N_B, and Total.
Figure 5 is the correlation heatmap. The participation axis is labeled SP. AAPI versus Year is -0.20. Gold and total rows are outlined.
Table 4 sets the forest at n_estimators 180, max_depth 10, min_samples_split 4. Table 5 sets XGBoost at eta 0.1, max_depth 6, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.8.
Figure 6 shows three fitted curves. Table 6 gives linear regression R2 0.8063, RMSE 15.44, fold R2 0.7066; XGBoost 0.8764, 12.33, 0.7597; random forest 0.8792, 12.19, 0.7642.
Figure 7 is the Task 1.1 flowchart. It prints USA gold 50 with bounds 43.47 and 55.22 and total 137, and it prints Germany total 43.
Table 7 is the 2028 virtual medal table through Brazil, with 2024 totals and a change column. USA +11 and Korea -6 are the extremes among the printed rows.
Table 8 gives 95 percent bounds for gold, silver, bronze, and total. Figure 8 is the ROC curve with area 0.94.
Table 9 lists seven first-medal probabilities. GUM is 0.153210476 on 8 athletes. COD is 0.12339206 on 6 athletes.
Figure 9 is the event-importance flowchart. Figure 10 is Germany's signed bar chart, canoeing positive and boxing negative.
Figure 11 is the six-country diverging bar chart. Swimming dominates. The United States swimming bar exceeds 1.
Table 10 is the 1996 new-event medal table. USA is highlighted at 41, 5, 18, total 64, with printed shares 33.33 and 17.63 percent.
Table 11 highlights Japan at 43, 4, 4, total 51. Table 12 highlights France at 1, 1, 1, total 3.
Table 13 is the Chinese women's volleyball history. Totals are fractional. The 2016 row has Great Coach 1 and Gold 1.
Table 14 pairs coach 0 and coach 1 for China gymnastics and swimming, Jamaica athletics, and Germany shooting and swimming.
Figure 12 overlays 60, 70, and 80 percent training fits on the actual series.
Figure 13 is the information-gain radar at 60, 70, 75, and 80 percent.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge can check that 0.8792 is above 0.8764 and that the prose still calls the models similar.
A judge can check that Table 10's printed percentages are not the row ratios.
A judge can check that the two China swimming rows match the two China men's gymnastics rows.

weaknesses.summary: New-event counts and printed percentages do not match.
Tokyo and Paris person-counts and percentages do not match.
Volleyball totals are fractional beside a prose claim of one bronze.
Two events share one Table 14 block, and 1.6 does not match every row.

independent_extensions.summary: The unnamed EPI weights could be stated as a separate normalization, without inventing values the paper does not print.

unresolved_questions: Figure 7 was read from the text layer. Its Germany total of 43 was not re-read from a crop.
Figure 10 bar heights were read from the chart, not from a printed table.
The three EPI weights have no numerical values.
Table 9 is captioned partial. Countries below COD were not on the page.
The BP network architecture and threshold are not stated.
PES is defined and never used. HA and HS are both host advantage.
